CONTENT: 01 - Preserve work and record the NAS configuration
Preserve all intended working-tree changes
DESCRIPTION: Review and commit explicit paths or back them up outside the checkout. Do not stage .env.

CONTENT: Back up the local environment configuration privately
DESCRIPTION: Keep credentials outside Git and preserve the working configuration before switching old branches.

CONTENT: Refresh and compare remote main and dev
DESCRIPTION: Fetch origin; record heads, common ancestor and ahead/behind counts. Recheck the guide's historical snapshot.

CONTENT: Create backup refs for main and dev
DESCRIPTION: Use unique backup branch names without overwriting existing refs.

CONTENT: Inventory the NAS and existing MongoDB deployment
DESCRIPTION: Record DSM/Container Manager versions, CPU/memory/storage, MongoDB version/FCV/digest, data mounts and permissions.

CONTENT: Rotate exposed credentials and check tracked secrets
DESCRIPTION: Review the old tracked .env history without printing secrets. Update affected runtime credentials.

CONTENT: Back up and test restoration of the full database and image library
DESCRIPTION: Include account progress, schema backups, uploaded files and JSON sidecars. Keep a copy off the NAS; restore into an isolated disposable location.

CONTENT: Gate: confirm preserved work and tested recovery
DESCRIPTION: Proceed only after intended work, the live database/mount and a usable backup are verified.

CONTENT: 02 - Establish passing tests and release checks
Include the completed dashboard and browser-test repairs
DESCRIPTION: The fixed fixture clock and updated dashboard selectors passed locally. Preserve these changes in the candidate branch.

CONTENT: Align the Node and npm toolchain
DESCRIPTION: Reconcile .node-version, packageManager, CI and local tooling; use the lockfile and npm ci.

CONTENT: Run lint, all normal tests and the production UI build
DESCRIPTION: Run npm run lint:ci, npm test and npm run ui:build. Record results and budget warnings.

CONTENT: Run browser integration against disposable local or CI MongoDB
DESCRIPTION: Set E2E_MONGODB_URI explicitly. Never give the destructive harness production credentials or point it at NAS production.

CONTENT: Verify MongoDB driver and server compatibility
DESCRIPTION: Review the pinned driver against the selected NAS MongoDB and Node versions. Test upgrades rather than downgrading the database to match old CI.

CONTENT: Match CI database coverage to the production server major
DESCRIPTION: Retain disposable MongoDB service containers and real JWT-validation tests. Keep test issuer injection inside the harness.

CONTENT: Track lint warnings separately from blocking errors
DESCRIPTION: Keep required checks failing on errors. Reduce the warning baseline in focused work before enforcing zero warnings.

CONTENT: Gate: record passing candidate-commit checks
DESCRIPTION: Require reproducible normal and browser passes on the actual candidate commit; previous local passes alone do not satisfy the release gate.

CONTENT: 03 - Reconcile dev and main
Create an isolated reconciliation worktree from origin/dev
DESCRIPTION: Preserve local .env, ignored files and untracked work; do not switch directly to the stale local main.

CONTENT: Merge origin/main into the reconciliation branch
DESCRIPTION: Use an ordinary merge between related histories. Do not force-push or use unrelated-history reconciliation.

CONTENT: Resolve conflicts and review removals deliberately
DESCRIPTION: Preserve maintained behavior from both histories; reconcile package.json and regenerate the lockfile when necessary.

CONTENT: Open and validate the reconciliation PR into dev
DESCRIPTION: Run the required checks and review before merging. Keep .env untracked.

CONTENT: Promote the reviewed dev tree to main through a PR
DESCRIPTION: Use a merge commit and retain the long-lived dev branch.

CONTENT: Back-merge main into dev and compare final trees
DESCRIPTION: Resolve reverse-sync conflicts through review. Confirm intended content matches without requiring identical commit hashes.

CONTENT: Gate: verify both histories and required checks are preserved
DESCRIPTION: Do not proceed with release automation until reconciliation and reverse sync are green.

CONTENT: 04 - Protect branches and automate reviewed merges
Configure main and dev branch protection
DESCRIPTION: Require PRs, required checks and resolved conversations. Prevent force pushes and branch deletion.

CONTENT: Verify CodeRabbit review and merge enforcement
DESCRIPTION: Confirm the app runs on a test PR and choose the actual status/review gate. Test a deliberately failing case.

CONTENT: Define a workable maintainer approval policy
DESCRIPTION: Require another maintainer's approval where available; avoid an impossible self-approval rule for a solo maintainer. Review sensitive changes manually.

CONTENT: Add a required release-ready aggregate check
DESCRIPTION: Depend on lint, tests, production build, browser/container checks and required security scans. Fail on failed, cancelled or unexpectedly skipped prerequisites.

CONTENT: Keep untrusted PR checks on hosted runners
DESCRIPTION: Use minimal permissions and no NAS credentials, production connection strings or LAN access.

CONTENT: Configure a narrowly scoped release-automation GitHub App
DESCRIPTION: Allow release PR management without branch-rule bypass. Ensure App-created PRs trigger the expected CI.

CONTENT: Automate one dev-to-main release PR and gated auto-merge
DESCRIPTION: Restrict automation to the intended repository and branches. Compare trees to avoid empty releases and reverse-sync loops; never use admin bypass.

CONTENT: Gate: prove failed checks block automatic merging
DESCRIPTION: Verify a green dev change creates one release PR and a failing change cannot reach main.

CONTENT: 05 - Package and publish tested immutable images
Add a production-safe Docker build context
DESCRIPTION: Exclude .env, Git metadata, database files, private uploads, dependencies and temporary browser/test data.

CONTENT: Build the production Angular web image and proxy
DESCRIPTION: Provide SPA fallback and same-origin /api routing before index.html fallback. Use production assets rather than ng serve.

CONTENT: Build a deployable middleware image
DESCRIPTION: Package shared code and aliases correctly. Do not omit tsx as a dev dependency while still relying on it at runtime.

CONTENT: Make API bind address and upload root configurable
DESCRIPTION: Bind internally to 0.0.0.0 in containers and retain a persistent image/sidecar volume. Keep the API port private.

CONTENT: Build a separate scheduled parser image
DESCRIPTION: Include headless Chromium and libraries, writable temporary profiles, resource limits and bounded execution. Validate browser sandbox support on DSM.

CONTENT: Build Linux AMD64 images with reviewed dependency pins
DESCRIPTION: Use the selected Node/npm toolchain, lockfile, pinned base images and reviewed action versions.

CONTENT: Test exact candidate images through the production proxy in CI
DESCRIPTION: Use disposable services to verify health, deep links, auth, account isolation, completion persistence, conflicts and uploads.

CONTENT: Scan dependencies, source, workflows, secrets and images
DESCRIPTION: Review findings; document time-limited exceptions. Include build-time dependencies in the assessment.

CONTENT: Publish tested main images and a verifiable release manifest
DESCRIPTION: Record commit SHA, immutable image digests, SBOM/provenance and schema/migration compatibility. Do not deploy latest.

CONTENT: Gate: confirm the published digests match the tested main release
DESCRIPTION: No secrets, database dumps or test authentication bypass may be packaged.

CONTENT: 06 - Prepare one production environment on the NAS
Create restricted deployment, secrets, release, backup and log directories
DESCRIPTION: Keep persistent production uploads and sidecars separate from replaceable images. No staging project or staging database is needed.

CONTENT: Preserve the existing MongoDB container and data mount
DESCRIPTION: Record its identity before changes. Never run two mongod processes against the same data directory or replace it with an empty mount.

CONTENT: Configure the reviewed Container Manager Compose project
DESCRIPTION: Verify the DSM Compose tooling and define production networks, volumes, limits, health checks and log rotation.

CONTENT: Create least-privilege runtime database credentials
DESCRIPTION: Separate application and parser users where practical; retain administrator credentials for maintenance and backup.

CONTENT: Configure private container networking and outbound access
DESCRIPTION: LAN proxy to web to API to MongoDB. API needs Auth0/JWKS egress; parser needs source-site egress. Do not publish backend ports.

CONTENT: Use the MongoDB service alias and internal port for NAS containers
DESCRIPTION: Use port 27017 on the private network. Restrict any retained host-published Compass port to trusted administrative devices.

CONTENT: Migrate existing images and metadata sidecars into persistent storage
DESCRIPTION: Confirm mounts do not hide required assets and releases cannot replace uploaded files.

CONTENT: Set protected runtime environment files and container permissions
DESCRIPTION: Keep secrets out of Git and images; use non-root app containers, limited writes, dropped capabilities and resource caps.

CONTENT: Keep unattended parser writes disabled until critical fixes are verified
DESCRIPTION: Resolve relevant cleanup/date/identity issues from the parser report; require locks, timeouts and accurate failure status.

CONTENT: Gate: verify production state and recovery paths before startup
DESCRIPTION: Confirm the intended database, uploads, credentials and backups. Validate restart persistence during the first maintenance deployment.

CONTENT: 07 - Automate maintenance deployment and rollback
Install a reviewed NAS pull-deployment task
DESCRIPTION: Schedule through DSM with an exclusive lock and protected script ownership. Do not expose an inbound webhook or NAS runner to PR code.

CONTENT: Validate release provenance and manifest contents
DESCRIPTION: Require expected repository, workflow, main ref, commit and allowed image digests. Update only approved image references; never execute downloaded shell payloads.

CONTENT: Pull and verify all images before touching live services
DESCRIPTION: Keep the current release running if download, provenance or required CI evidence fails.

CONTENT: Add approval holds for the first release and sensitive changes
DESCRIPTION: Keep schema/auth/workflow releases manual until recovery behavior is demonstrated. Enable unattended routine releases only after successful deployments.

CONTENT: Implement maintenance mode and a consistent pre-deploy backup
DESCRIPTION: Block user writes, pause parser jobs, drain requests and stop API writers. Back up DB plus assets and record previous digests/schema before replacement.

CONTENT: Replace the single production web/API release in place
DESCRIPTION: Expect a short maintenance window. Account for migration-capable API startup; no staging or blue/green environment is available.

CONTENT: Run controlled production health and smoke checks before reopening traffic
DESCRIPTION: Use the real LAN origin and designated test accounts/records. Never run the destructive E2E harness against production.

CONTENT: Implement schema-aware failure recovery
DESCRIPTION: Keep maintenance active on failure. Restore previous images only if compatible; use deliberate DB/assets recovery when needed. Never automatically restore after user writes resume.

CONTENT: Record deployment results and notify on failures
DESCRIPTION: Retain current/previous digests and redacted logs; reopen LAN access and resume approved jobs only after successful checks.

CONTENT: Gate: demonstrate a successful release and a recoverable failure
DESCRIPTION: Prove verification failure leaves production unchanged and a failed live release follows the recovery procedure.

CONTENT: 08 - Configure LAN-only DNS, HTTPS and Auth0
Reserve the NAS address and choose the production LAN hostname
DESCRIPTION: Use one stable origin and allowed LAN subnet list. No staging hostname or publicly reachable application is required.

CONTENT: Configure local DNS for the website hostname
DESCRIPTION: Resolve the chosen hostname to the reserved NAS address. Do not publish an application A/AAAA record for internet access.

CONTENT: Install and renew a certificate trusted by every client
DESCRIPTION: Use an owned-domain certificate with DNS validation or a correctly trusted internal CA. Verify hostname and Auth0 compatibility; do not bypass browser TLS errors.

CONTENT: Configure the LAN HTTPS reverse proxy and firewall
DESCRIPTION: Route the exact hostname to web and allow only intended LAN subnets. Review IPv6 and guest VLAN access.

CONTENT: Disable public ingress paths for this application
DESCRIPTION: No router forwarding, UPnP mapping, public tunnel or alternate direct-origin route.

CONTENT: Set exact Auth0 callback, logout and web-origin URLs
DESCRIPTION: Use the final HTTPS LAN origin; set APP_ORIGIN to the same origin. Preserve issuer/audience/account mapping and avoid broad wildcards.

CONTENT: Verify real Google/Auth0 login from LAN devices
DESCRIPTION: Check refresh, new tabs, logout and access denial. Browsers and NAS still need outbound internet for authentication and service dependencies.

CONTENT: Migrate guest progress to the new browser origin if needed
DESCRIPTION: Export/import local guest data; account progress remains in MongoDB. Local filters and reading positions do not transfer automatically.

CONTENT: Gate: confirm LAN access works and off-network access fails
DESCRIPTION: Verify trusted HTTPS, deep links, login, uploads and persistence on LAN; confirm unreachability using mobile data and firewall inspection.

CONTENT: 09 - Verify runtime security and recovery
Patch DSM and restrict NAS administration
DESCRIPTION: Enable administrator MFA, review permissions and restrict DSM/SSH to trusted administrative access.

CONTENT: Test API authorization and account isolation
DESCRIPTION: Reject wrong, expired or invalid tokens; enforce editor permissions on the server.

CONTENT: Correct proxy-aware rate limiting and request bounds
DESCRIPTION: Trust client IP only through the controlled proxy path. Prevent shared-proxy quota problems, spoofed headers and unbounded requests/uploads.

CONTENT: Enforce appropriate security headers and private-response caching rules
DESCRIPTION: Test CSP before enforcement; configure frame/referrer/permissions protections and no-store for private APIs. Cache static assets separately.

CONTENT: Review markdown, links and token handling for XSS risk
DESCRIPTION: Verify sanitization, safe DOM behavior, dependency patches and CSP. Logout does not revoke every issued bearer token.

CONTENT: Validate upload handling and anonymous data exposure
DESCRIPTION: Check MIME/content/path/size/authorization and serving headers. Keep debug files, backups, secrets and private records out of public-facing catalog responses.

CONTENT: Verify off-NAS backups, monitoring and restore ownership
DESCRIPTION: Alert on failed backups/deploys/parsers, stale data, API errors and storage pressure. Keep logs rotated and secrets redacted.

CONTENT: Gate: sign off the LAN security and recovery checklist
DESCRIPTION: Use destructive security tests only in disposable CI services; keep live verification controlled and non-destructive.

CONTENT: 10 - Launch and operate the LAN site
Approve and schedule the first production maintenance deployment
DESCRIPTION: Confirm exact release digests, required checks, backups and rollback instructions before starting.

CONTENT: Verify the first live release before opening general LAN access
DESCRIPTION: Check catalog IDs/counts, account progress, editor writes, conflicts, images, deep links, auth and refresh persistence.

CONTENT: Confirm restart persistence and observe NAS resource use
DESCRIPTION: Ensure images and database state survive restarts; review logs and health after reopening traffic.

CONTENT: Enable reviewed parser jobs one at a time
DESCRIPTION: Use non-overlap locks, timeouts, failure/freshness alerts and correct game-server timezone behavior.

CONTENT: Enable automatic deployment for eligible routine releases
DESCRIPTION: Require exact main-commit CI and provenance. Retain explicit holds for migrations and security-sensitive changes.

CONTENT: Document the operational and recovery owner
DESCRIPTION: Record backup/restore steps, rollback compatibility, certificate renewal, credential rotation and incident notifications without storing secrets in tasks.

CONTENT: Gate: close the LAN deployment project
DESCRIPTION: Confirm aligned branches, enforced CI/review, verified NAS pull deployment, one persistent production environment, LAN-only HTTPS and working recovery.
